explication: NoteDiscovery is a self-hosted Markdown knowledge base. Users write and organize notes in the web app, which communicates with the FastAPI backend and stores notes as files; discovery features include search, tags, backlinks, and a knowledge graph. AI clients can also access notes through the MCP server and its HTTP client. The graph preserves README capabilities such as sharing, export, drawing, themes, and plugins. Some feature-specific implementation paths are not shown, so their placement and connections are omitted where evidence is insufficient.
